### Installing radian for R (H4H/local)

See: [randy3k/radian](https://github.com/randy3k/radian)

1. Open a terminal
2. Install pipx: `micromamba install conda-forge::pipx`
3. Install radian: `pipx install radian`

## R Linters

We use multiple linters:

* air ([posit-dev.github.io/air](https://posit-dev.github.io/air/))
  * Included in VS Code profile extensions list.
  * [template](templates/configs/air.toml)
* lintr ([lintr.r-lib.org](https://lintr.r-lib.org))
  * [template](templates/configs/.lintr)
* styler ([github.com/r-lib/styler](https://github.com/r-lib/styler))
* jarl ([jarl.etiennebacher.com](https://jarl.etiennebacher.com))

> NOTE: "[lintr](https://lintr.r-lib.org/) is complementary to  **[the `{styler}` package](https://github.com/r-lib/styler) which automatically restyles code, eliminating some of the problems that** [lintr](https://lintr.r-lib.org/) can detect."

> See also [COMING SOON] [GaitiLab/style](https://github.com/GaitiLab/style) (style guide for R adapted for our lab)
